reports.en: Widespread Arab solidarity after a fire. The Gulf Cooperation Council expresses its condolences to the families of the victims and wishes to heal the injured. Iraq, Libya, Oman and Somalia offer condolences. And Abu Mazen affirms Palestine's full solidarity with Egypt.
